lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sub-parallel horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill region; spacing between centroids increases along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal blob rows to form a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal line on the dorsal-lateral interface characterized by a sharp luminance step-down gradient, indicating a structural ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, uniform high-luminance spots on the visible surface of the extended left pectoral fin.
